name: ornn-github-profile
description: Tooling to lint, link-check, and preview the Ornn-AI public GitHub organization profile.

scripts.check-links: for f in README.md AGENTS.md profile/README.md; do echo "# $f" && markdown-link-check --quiet --config .markdown-link-check.json "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run check-links
